newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo 1996 net attrib profit 1.2 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Valeo 1996 net attrib profit 1.2 bln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE: Valeo said in a statement that net income after minority interests rose 18.8 percent to 1.2 billion francs or 4.2 percent of consolidated sales. Gross margin was up 16.3 percent and operating income by 35.7 percent. "Income before tax stands at 1.484 million francs, up by 37.4 percent over the previous year. This increase would have been 58.9 percent excluding the extraordinary capital gain of 146 million francs made in 1995."

The 12 franc net dividend includes a 10 franc extraordinary dividend per share paid out on November 18 related to the transfer of Cerus's 27.4 percent stake in Valeo to CGIP. It said the shareholder's meeting would be asked to approve an additional dividend of two francs per share.

At end 1996 equity rose to 10,556 million francs after the payment of an extraordinary dividend of 700 million francs. Equity at the end of 1995 was 10 billion francs. Net debt in 1996 was 673 million francs, six percent of equity, up from 171 million in 1995.
